jin: Heads-up — kirin15b (int4) canary is hitting OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 1024. Repro on 2/8 canaries after yesterday's kernel patch.

tara: Thanks. Quick Qs — what's the traffic pattern and batch settings where it fails?

jin: Synthetic repro I ran: single prompt ~1k tokens, max_new_tokens=1500, batch_size=4 (local), but prod default batch_size is 8. generation_window=2048. Failures show during KV growth phase. Logs attached below.

jin: ```
[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] ERROR OOM allocating chunk size=536870912
[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] model=kirin15b variant=int4 batch_id=42 seq_len=2500 peak_mem=11.2GB
[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] kv_cache_usage rising: 1.8GB -> 6.9GB in 120s
Stack: allocator::alloc_chunk -> kv_cache::append -> attention::prefetch
```

leo: Hmm looks like fragmentation + KV spike. Are we doing prefix caching for these requests? Also which prefetch mode and slot_reserve are we on?

jin: prefix_cache=true, prefetch=enabled, kv_gc=auto, batcher=continuous, slot_reserve=0.1. Kernel is the 03/21 optimized attention patch.

leo: Two quick hypotheses: (A) prefetch + large max_new causes many small allocations that fragment the heap; (B) batch_size 8 in prod pushes simultaneous KV growth causing peaks.

tara: Proposed mitigations to try in canary: 
- reduce default max_new_tokens for kirin15b to 512 on hosted and dedicated by policy
- increase slot_reserve to 0.2 for canary nodes
- cap batch_size to 4 for requests where client_max_new > 1024 (soft microbatching)
- enable windowed-evict (soft KV eviction at 75% usage)

mike: Also suggest turning on the alternate kernel "windowed-evict" for this model variant — we saw ~10–12% peak mem reduction on a different 15B int4 last month. Microbatching will increase end-to-end latency a bit but avoids OOM. :thumbsup:

jin: I'll run an A/B soak with these changes: baseline vs (slot_reserve=0.2, batch_cap=4, default_max_new=512, windowed-evict). Plan: 30m synthetic soak + 1hr mixed traffic sample. Will report p95 latency, tail mem, and OOM count.

tara: Sounds good. Acceptance criteria: OOMs=0 for soak and p95 latency delta < 10% vs baseline. If passes, roll to 25% for 24h.

deploy-bot: deploy request created (id=deploy-1764444444). Canary config: slot_reserve=0.2, batch_size_cap=4, default_max_new_tokens=512, windowed_evict=on. Rolling canary on 3 nodes.

jin: running now — will post results in ~90m.
